scope: Static candidate-source and bounded transport CPU review; synthetic fixtures, no product build, CI, evaluation or measurement.

checks.name: all three exact frozen sources accepted without transformation
reject missing and additional candidate paths
Git blob uses the actual NUL framing
complete ten-file transport round-trip including zero bytes and chunk boundaries

output path traversal refuses before first export record
reordered file set refuses before first export record
failed status refuses before first export record
accurately hashed final file above 4 MiB refuses before first export record
report above 4 MiB refuses before first export record
wrong input-set failure preserves report before any build command or source write
